# Conexión: Entrepreneur Summit has begun, three days to celebrate Medellín's entrepreneurial ecosystem.

**Articulating and revitalizing Medellín's entrepreneurial ecosystem is the challenge of** [**Conexión: Entrepreneur Summit**](https://www.taquillalive.com/eventos-y-boleteria/?keyword=conexion) **, taking place from today until October 4 at Plaza Mayor. This event brings together entrepreneurs, investors, and large corporations to forge new business deals and explore transformative opportunities.**

**During the event, 50 shortlisted** _**startups**_ **will have the opportunity to connect with 67 investment funds from 22 countries. The organizers of the event—EAFIT, CES, EIA, the Mayor's Office of Medellín, Ruta N, Plaza Mayor, and DGroupe—hope to generate a significant economic impact and position the city in global entrepreneurship rankings.**

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/)
- [News](https://www.eafit.edu.co/noticias)
- [Our Impact](https://www.eafit.edu.co/noticias/nuestro-impacto)
- Conexión has begun: Entrepreneur Summit, Three Days to Celebrate Medellín's Entrepreneurial Ecosystem

![Image Connection Began: Entrepreneur Summit, three days to celebrate Medellín's entrepreneurial ecosystem](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/e7712e98-cf54-4110-ae0b-3da297bde24b/web/Conexion-Entrepreneur.jpg?crop=yes&k=c&w=823&h=450&itok=4CPTrx0T)

After two years, Medellín is once again the setting for an event focused on entrepreneurship.

Amidst sculptures and artworks, workshops, brainstorming sessions, _masterclasses_ , podcast recordings, and private meetings between investment funds, _speakers_ , and entrepreneurs are taking place. This is the atmosphere at Plaza Mayor with Conexión: Entrepreneur Summit, an event that aims to connect Medellín's ecosystem with Latin America and foster conversations that drive investment, business, networking, and knowledge sharing.

Until October 4, participants in this event—organized by the universities _CES, EIA_ and _EAFIT_ , through their entrepreneurship center On.going, and DGroupe, in partnership with the Mayor's Office of Medellín, Ruta N and Plaza Mayor—will be able to listen to more than 20 national and international speakers, while 50 _startups_ present their work and connect with 67 investment funds from 22 countries, with the aim of closing deals and exploring alternatives for transformation and adaptation to new technological capabilities.

“We want to bridge the gap between entrepreneurs, investors, and business owners,” said Tomás Ríos Múnera, director of _On.going_   EAFIT and co-founder of Conexión, who pointed out that Medellín lags behind in terms of attracting investment, with only $154 million, while cities like Bogotá reach $400 million. Currently, Medellín has 6 _startups_ per 100,000 inhabitants, and Bogotá has between 8 and 9.

Tomás also emphasized that: “Large ecosystems worldwide have developed from universities, and it is essential to leverage initiatives from there. In Colombia, we want to contribute to that ecosystem, which is why On.going EAFIT was created, to encourage these ideas, since that is where the solutions to future problems begin.”

María Fernanda Galeano Rojo, Medellín's Secretary of Economic Development, stated that the city has lost its former momentum and has fallen out of international rankings. According to the Secretary, entrepreneurs face significant challenges in terms of financing, making it crucial to forge connections with investment funds to achieve their goals.

“We need entrepreneurs who can help us solve problems related to security, mobility, and the environment, and who can revitalize the city's entertainment sector, as well as the audiovisual and film industries. The idea is that, with all these investments and opportunities, we can continue to advance as a competitive, global city, based on science, technology, and innovation,” the secretary stated.

Given this scenario, Edrizio de la Cruz, co-founder of Founder School and a guest speaker at one of the Conexión talks, emphasized that in Medellín “there is a lot of potential and talent, but the challenge is not starting, but climbing. Anyone can start a marathon, but the important thing is to finish it.”

He also indicated that training for entrepreneurs is vital, since without tools and quality education it is difficult to achieve a virtuous cycle.

Before the first day began, Claudia Restrepo Montoya, Rector of EAFIT University, greeted the attendees and reaffirmed the event's objective. “This is a space for connection. This meeting represents creating connections and making the ecosystem much stronger for the entire country. This is about building community. We hope it will be the first of many actions we will take as a district to promote this business network.”

###### _Made in Medellín:_ The entrepreneurial ecosystem that focuses on collaboration and innovation

Conexión began with the _Made in Medellín_ panel , where local entrepreneurs shared their experiences and reflections on what it has been like to start a business in the city, the future of their initiatives, and the challenges ahead. This meeting, moderated by Andrés Raigoza of the ANDI Entrepreneurship Chamber, highlighted the importance of collaboration between _startups_ , investors, and the local ecosystem to strengthen Medellín's global competitiveness.

Pamela Richter, CEO y cofundadora de B2Chat, resaltó el valor de la infraestructura tecnológica de la ciudad y la facilidad para conectarse con programas de aceleración y financiamiento. "Emprender desde Medellín ha sido espectacular. Tenemos muchos apoyos en la ciudad, así la gente no lo crea. La inteligencia artificial nos dará la rapidez que necesitamos, pero los humanos siguen dando la seguridad. Siempre recordamos a las organizaciones esa importancia del soporte humano detrás de las actividades para generar comunidad", señaló.

Por su parte, Juan Esteban Hincapié, cofundador de Erco Energy, subrayó el papel crucial de la energía renovable en el futuro de Medellín. “La energía solar ya es una realidad en muchos hogares, pero necesitamos mejorar la financiación y la regulación para que el acceso sea más rápido y eficiente”, comentó. Desde su perspectiva, en los próximos años, tecnologías como el hidrógeno verde podrían transformar aún más el panorama energético.

Pablo Santos, CEO y cofundador de Finaktiva, habló sobre cómo su plataforma ha impulsado el crecimiento de pequeñas y medianas empresas en Colombia, destacando el potencial del sector fintech para transformar los servicios financieros. "En Medellín hemos evolucionado, y con la tecnología adecuada, estamos creando soluciones que permiten a las pymes crecer de manera sostenible. Emprender en Medellín es hacerlo de manera colectiva. ¿Cómo construir tecnología entendiendo los dolores de las compañías? Hemos comprendido que, con tecnología y datos bien usados, podemos potenciar las industrias", explicó.

El panel concluyó con una reflexión sobre el "ADN emprendedor" de Medellín. Los panelistas coincidieron en que la ciudad tiene una capacidad única para colaborar, crear redes y asumir riesgos. “Lo más importante es que no tengamos miedo de conectarnos con el mundo”, afirmó Andrés Raigoza, quien hizo un llamado a seguir construyendo comunidades que impulsen el desarrollo empresarial y social de la ciudad.

Conexión: Entrepreneur Summit apenas comienza, y aún quedan muchas actividades destacadas por venir, con la participación de _speakers_ nacionales e internacionales, como Chris Knight, general manager de Roc Nation; Olek Lowenstein, presidente de la División Global de Deportes de TelevisaUnivision; Elkin De La Hoz, creador de Dímelo King; Wilder Zapata, CEO y cofundador de Action Black; y Gaby Muñoz, CEO y cofundadora de Taxia Life, entre otros, quienes compartirán sus conocimientos y experiencias.

metadata.og:title: Inició Conexión: Entrepreneur Summit, tres días para celebrar el ecosistema emprendedor de Medellín
metadata.ogDescription: ​En medio de esculturas y piezas artísticas se llevan a cabo talleres, laboratorios de ideación, masterclasses, grabaciones de pódcast y reuniones privadas entre fondos de inversión, speakers y emprendedores.
